Class Pop3Client

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.net.email.Pop3Client
public final class Pop3Client extends Object
A minimal POP3S client recognized as a compiler intrinsic by Juno, backed by Arduino's WiFiSSLClient — the same implicit-TLS mechanism as HttpsClient, needing no extra library. Requires @Board(ArduinoUnoR4WiFi.class) and an active Wifi.begin(String, String) connection.

host, username, and password must be compile-time strings (a literal, or System.getenv("NAME") of a literal name). Responses use caller-owned buffers; there is no heap allocation.

  • Method Details

    • messageCount

      public static int messageCount(String host, int port, String username, String password)
      Returns the mailbox's message count (STAT), or a negative code identifying the failing step: connect (-1), greeting (-2), USER (-3), PASS (-4), or STAT (-5).

    • readLatest

      public static int readLatest(String host, int port, String username, String password, byte[] headersBuffer, int headersBufferLength, byte[] bodyBuffer, int bodyBufferLength, int[] status)
      Retrieves the newest message (RETR on the highest message number from STAT), writing "From: ...\n" and "Subject: ...\n" (whichever are present, each bounded to headersBuffer) into headersBuffer and the plain-text body (dot-unstuffed, bounded to bodyBuffer) into bodyBuffer. status[0] is set to the number of bytes written to headersBuffer. Returns the number of bytes written to bodyBuffer on success, or a negative code identifying the failing step: connect (-1), greeting (-2), USER (-3), PASS (-4), STAT (-5), an empty mailbox (-6), RETR (-7), or a connection drop while streaming the message (-8).

    • readSubject

      public static int readSubject(String host, int port, String username, String password, int messageNumber, byte[] subjectBuffer, int subjectBufferLength)
      Reads message messageNumber's Subject header only, via TOP messageNumber 0 (headers, no body) — cheap enough to call once per message when listing a mailbox, unlike readLatest(String, int, String, String, byte[], int, byte[], int, int[]). messageNumber is 1-based POP3 numbering ( 1 is the oldest message still in the mailbox). Writes the subject's value (bounded to subjectBuffer, no trailing newline) into subjectBuffer. Returns the number of bytes written on success (which is 0 for a message with no Subject header), or a negative code identifying the failing step: connect (-1), greeting (-2), USER (-3), PASS (-4), TOP ( -5), or a connection drop while streaming the headers (-6).
